title: Persistent line process
responsibility: Keeps a lazily started child process for sequential line exchanges and converts startup, exit and timeout failures to runtime responses.

inputs.name: lineProcess.command
inputs.description: Executable to spawn on the first exchange or after the previous child stops.

inputs.name: lineProcess.args
inputs.description: Arguments passed directly to the child process with piped standard streams.

inputs.name: unavailable.command
inputs.description: Executable name to identify in a startup-failure message.

inputs.name: unavailable.error
inputs.description: Startup error whose message should be included.

inputs.name: exited.code
inputs.description: Exit status, or null when no numeric status is known.

inputs.name: exited.stderr
inputs.description: Error-output text to trim and include up to its last 200 characters.

outputs.name: lineProcess
outputs.description: Handle with exchange and close methods. Exchange writes one normalized line and waits for a response line or timeout; close kills the child with SIGKILL and clears its buffer.

outputs.name: unavailable
outputs.description: Runtime failure with code runtime-unavailable and the command/startup error message.

outputs.name: exited
outputs.description: Runtime failure with code runtime-failed, exit status and optional trimmed stderr detail.
